fact: Decree 2-24-921, published in Bulletin officiel no. 7352 (November 2024), sets a two-level qualification regime for cloud providers that State administrations, local authorities, public bodies and critical infrastructures must use for sensitive systems and data, with a two-year transition for those using unqualified providers.
title: Cloud souverain: le Maroc franchit un pas décisif… sur le terrain juridique
